source.title: Belfast Newsletter, 18 May 1967, p. 2 ("Bunting unopposed in Down")
source.publisher: Belfast Newsletter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: returned unopposed: 'Major Ronald Bunting, chairman of the Association, is unopposed in standing for the Holywood ward... His opponent, Mr. R. C. Crawford withdrew from the contest just before the nominations closed yesterday afternoon' (Belfast Newsletter, 18 May 1967, p. 2)

note: Election of the Down County Council, polled 1 June 1967 (Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8, 'Round Up of the County Councils'). The returning officer's 'Notice of result of elections, 1967' (Belfast Newsletter, 6 June 1967, p. 8) names the member elected for all twenty divisions: eighteen were returned unopposed and Kilkeel and Newry were polled. Ratepayers' Association nominee; the withdrawal of R. C. Crawford left him unopposed. Returned unopposed.
